I2C 0x69, CSB tied high; unused AUX pins DNC never GND. 100nF at each supply pin. Firmware must upload Bosch config blob; boot is not plug-and-play.

CAP1296-1-AIA-TR; 3.3V supply; fixed 7-bit I2C 0x28. DFN10 exposed ground pad is numbered 11 in this custom symbol and footprint. All six CS inputs wired through 1k resistors to ELE0..ELE5. CS3/SG used as CS3, no guard. R6=10k IRQ pull-up; C11=100nF/C12=1uF supply bypass. Enable only physically fitted electrodes in firmware; disable and ground unused CS inputs per datasheet. Tune thresholds and filtering on actual enclosure. Measure I2C rise time with final bus capacitance and existing pull-ups. GPIO40 IRQ is preserved and is not RTC deep-sleep wake. Firmware critical: clear 0x2A MULT_BLK_EN bit7 for simultaneous grip/rim touches; keep MTP_EN disabled and 0x20 MAX_DUR_EN bit3=0 for long grip. Any unused CS channel must be disabled and grounded, not left floating. Engineering candidate, not tested hardware.

Seven-pin logical interface only: 1..6=ELE0..ELE5; 7=GND reference. Physical connector, pitch, mating orientation, shield termination and exact physical numbering remain TBD. Not compatible with previous 12-pin logical order. No physical connector footprint or catalog MPN assigned.

TQFN16+EP (logical EP17 must match chosen footprint). Floating GAIN gives9dB. SD_MODE driven through0R from AMP_ENABLE,10k pulldown; high selects LEFT channel, low shutdown. Firmware sends mono to left slot (or duplicate both); right-only audio is silent. SD_MODE selects channel/shutdown, NOT gain; gain is set by GAIN_SLOT. This is a deliberate default-off modification of old bias network. Speaker BTL neither wire GND. Keep clocks/data/enable LOW before +5V_SYS rises and before it falls; firmware sequencing validation required.
Two-wire BTL harness connector only. LS1 is the one offboard 8-ohm 2W speaker. Neither wire is GND. Connector and cable assembly remain TBD.

DRV2605LDGSR专用LRA驱动，DGS10脚VSSOP无EP。6/10脚接同一+3V3逻辑轨，实际目标3.192V，不接5V。I2C地址0x5A，VIH≥1.3V、VIL≤0.5V；沿用4.7k上拉，先100kHz验证。4脚IN/TRIG接地；1脚REG仅接1µF去耦，不带外部负载。7/9脚差分输出直连LRA，不接地、不保留ERM续流或跨端电容。GPIO6 EN默认下拉关闭。EN低不清寄存器，甚至可能ACK但不能读写。上电等待≥250µs，显式复位、型号匹配配置、读回及校准后只播放有限时长单次效果。4.33ms看门狗只复位I2C协议，不是失联停振；待机总线锁死可能需整机断电。主控复位可下拉EN，卡死保持高时仍靠有限波形及主控看门狗；无独立硬件超时保证。TI8.3.12.4：欠压恢复斜率低于3.6kV/s可能状态未知，须完整断电并以更快斜率重新上电，EN切换不能保证恢复。输出电压寄存器存在厂家公式勘误疑点，不猜十六进制配置；须差分测量Vrms和峰值。实测带振动负载逻辑轨3.0–3.3V，核温升、IMU和触摸干扰。
1k串联电阻，GPIO6至DRV2605L EN；不是执行器PWM功率驱动。

LEADER LD0832BC-0195F，Z轴LRA，非ERM。额定1.8Vrms正弦，工作0.1–1.9Vrms，235±10Hz，谐振时≤90mArms，21±3Ω。100g夹具≥1Grms不代表整机手感。主体Ø8±0.1×3.25±0.1mm，另加0.3mm泡棉与0.15mm背胶；短双焊盘FPC从中心到尾10.4±0.2mm、尾宽4.2mm，不是出厂导线，也不是屏幕0.5mm排线。柔性引线焊接、应变释放及固定需工艺验证，不拉扯或挤压执行器。差分输出两端不能接地或直流电源。额定/最大值是RMS，名义正弦峰值2.546/2.687V不等于驱动寄存器数值。不得假设允许额外高压过驱；装壳后校准诊断，先低幅有限脉冲，再差分测量确认电压、温升和手感。
